summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload on npm install
details: The package advertises itself as a React chat UI component library but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook that executes arbitrary code on the installer's host. package.json declares "preinstall": "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun (bun-v1.3.13) and then invokes execFileSync(bun, [math_init.js]) against a sibling file. math_init.js is a 727KB opaque bundle with obfuscator-style shuffled string-array construction (a rotator function WV8StW cycling a large dictionary literal) and hex/random identifier names, with no readable source, no exports, and no relationship to a chat UI. The use of a second language runtime to execute the payload evades Node-based inspection. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are obfuscated. Running `npm install` on any consumer triggers arbitrary code execution on the installer's host under the alternate runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
